author: Nick Cruz
why: Classic snowy Cotopaxi above dry páramo grass, with blue sky and a prominent cone; a strong starting point for the 9:10 card.

author: ryan doyle
why: Explicitly captioned Cotopaxi from the national park; open grassland and blue tones provide the requested classic landscape setting.

author: Mauricio Muñoz
why: Snow-covered Cotopaxi photographed with a Nikon D7000; blue sky and a distinct summit offer another recognisable landscape composition.

author: César Viteri
why: Photographer-confirmed Cotopaxi at dawn above Quito's lights; atmospheric alternative with a snowy summit and illuminated foreground.

author: Andres Medina
why: Cotopaxi with green vegetation and wildflowers, photographed with a Sony A7 III; a colourful foreground alternative to the dry-páramo views.
